spec2def(mciqtz32.dll mciqtz32.spec)

# mciqtz32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mciqtz32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(mciqtz32_shims OBJECT mciqtz.c)
target_link_libraries(mciqtz32_shims PRIVATE wine strmiids libwinmm libole32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(mciqtz32_shims)
add_dependencies(mciqtz32_shims dxsdk)
add_cargo_module(mciqtz32 mciqtz32-cargo mciqtz32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mciqtz32_shims psdk)
